items.objective: Add backend configuration for an explicit RAGFlow path, including enablement, base URL, API key, default dataset IDs, optional rerank ID, retrieval tuning, and generation model.
acceptance: Backend settings expose explicit RAGFlow retrieval and generation knobs.
Default RAGFlow retrieval is disabled until an operator opts in.
Dataset and document IDs parse from comma-separated env values.

items.objective: Add a RAGFlow retrieval service that calls `POST /api/v1/retrieval`, validates configuration, normalizes chunks/citations, and fails loudly when required config or datasets are missing.
acceptance: Service posts to `/api/v1/retrieval` with bearer auth.
Service passes `rerank_id` when configured or requested.
Service raises clear config errors instead of falling back to Gemini or Claude.

items.objective: Add `/ragflow/retrieve` and `/ragflow/chat/stream` endpoints that mirror existing Gemini/Claude assistant surfaces without falling back to vendor retrieval.
acceptance: `/ragflow/config` hides API key material.
`/ragflow/retrieve` returns normalized chunks and citations.
`/ragflow/chat/stream` emits retrieval, text, and done SSE events using the configured DeepSeek-compatible model.

items.objective: Add backend tests for config validation, RAGFlow request payloads, response normalization, and router behavior.
acceptance: Focused RAGFlow tests cover request payloads, missing dataset errors, HTTP request shape, chunk normalization, endpoint responses, SSE streaming, and API-key hiding.

items.objective: Update operator-facing env documentation so local BGE-M3 embedding and rerank setup is discoverable without changing existing Gemini/Claude paths.
acceptance: Env documentation states that BGE-M3 embedding setup belongs in RAGFlow dataset configuration.
Env documentation tells the operator where to configure the RAGFlow reranker ID.

items.objective: Produce proof artifacts: source manifest, lane proof, command logs, plan contract verification, and proof dashboard.
acceptance: Source manifest verifies.
Plan gate verifies.
Lane proof verifies.
Plan contract verifies with local commands.
Local RAGFlow smoke proves BGE-M3 indexed retrieval returns the sentinel chunk.
MOS backend smoke proves live RAGFlow retrieval plus DeepSeek streaming returns the sentinel answer.
verify_commands: jq -e '.status == "PASS" and .embedding_model == "bge-m3@Ollama" and (.retrieval.chunks | length) >= 1 and ((.retrieval | tostring) | contains("MOS_RAGFLOW_BGE_M3_LOCAL_VECTOR_BRIDGE_20260527"))' proof_pack/ragflow-bge-m3-retrieval/ragflow-local-smoke-result.json

jq -e '.status == "PASS" and .model == "deepseek:deepseek-v4-pro" and .retrieval_sentinel_found == true and .answer_sentinel_found == true' proof_pack/ragflow-bge-m3-retrieval/mos-backend-ragflow-deepseek-smoke-result.json

items.objective: parallelizable: yes, but native sub-agents are blocked by active tool policy.
acceptance: Lane proof records local parallel tool mode and native sub-agent block reason.

items.objective: parallelization map: local parallel reads/source capture; main thread owns implementation and verification.
acceptance: Lane proof records source capture, repo inspection, implementation, and verification lanes.

items.objective: expected speed gain: local parallel tools reduce read/source-capture time without risking overlapping writes.
acceptance: Lane proof has no overlapping write ownership conflicts.

items.objective: token spend justification: no native sub-agents used.
acceptance: Lane proof token/time proxy records native sub-agent block and local verification mode.

items.objective: write ownership: main thread only for backend service/router/config/tests/docs.
acceptance: Lane proof records one implementation write owner.

items.objective: fan-in plan: main thread integrates and verifies.
acceptance: Lane proof fan-in summary status is pass.
Lane proof records main-thread verification.

items.objective: meta-tooling opportunity: if more RAG providers are added, extract a shared retrieval-provider interface after this first path is proven.
acceptance: Meta-tooling opportunity is documented in the plan and deferred until a second provider path exists.

global_verify_commands: cd mos/backend && .venv/bin/python -m compileall app/services/ragflow_retrieval.py app/routers/ragflow.py app/config.py app/main.py
cd mos/backend && .venv/bin/ruff check app/services/ragflow_retrieval.py app/routers/ragflow.py tests/test_ragflow_retrieval.py
global_acceptance: RAGFlow path is parallel to Gemini and Claude.
No fallback to Gemini, Claude, or another retrieval provider is introduced.
DeepSeek remains the generation layer behind explicit model config.
RAGFlow retrieval supports local BGE-M3 embedding/rerank configuration through RAGFlow itself.
